title: AssistantResponse
description: The AI assistant's conversational output — a short Hebrew sentence + optional follow-up chips. Rendered above the product grid. Arrives before product cards via the two-phase parallel fetch.

message.description: Short Hebrew sentence (1–2 max). Empty string when tone is none. Never a greeting, never a restatement of product names.

tone.description: answer: factual answer to a question (from catalog only — never invented). clarify: AI needs more info. suggest: recommendation or framing. none: nothing useful to say; message is empty.

follow_ups.description: 0–2 short Hebrew follow-up questions rendered as clickable chips below the results.
